name: XDKNet 3.0.1.0
body:
XDKNet 3.0.1.0 brings in Moonfin 3.1.1. Update the server plugin to 3.0.1.0
as well: the new MDBList, JustWatch and TMDB rows, Seerr's waiting-on line
and the Seerr test notification need it.

## Home and the media bar

- **Carousel rows**: a new row type with a details panel under each row.
  TVs that never picked a row type start on it.
- **New Releases** now covers new movies too, with a New Movie label that can
  show the tagline, and its own New Episode Window and New Movie Window.
- **MDBList, JustWatch and TMDB discover rows**: popular and trending titles
  by service, and the Home Rows editor groups outside lists by source.
- **Hide Watch Progress** and **Hide Unwatched Count** now cover library
  posters too.
- Media bar trailer previews are off unless you turn them on.
- On Now refreshes when you come back to Home, a playing media bar trailer
  stops when its slide changes, and Latest cards from an episode or season
  show the show's logo.
- Seerr Discover rows use Home's row padding.

## Libraries and details

- **Merge Movie and TV Show Libraries** (with Multi-Server Libraries on):
  one Movies and one TV Shows library across your servers, each title once.
- Marking a season unplayed drops its Resume and progress straight away, and
  marking a title watched keeps OK on Watched.
- Frost's Similar tab shows Seerr posters. Photo albums include their videos,
  and swiping changes photos.

## The player

- Holding Left or Right on the remote seeks in growing steps, up to 30, 60
  and 180 seconds. Holding Space plays at double speed.
- The paused description appears as soon as you pause, up to 8 lines.
- Subtitles the server converts (MP4 timed text) show on Android TV.
- Passthrough sound comes back after a pause on TVs such as the TCL G10.
- A Stop sent from another app closes the player instead of leaving it
  black; a quick Down to the player buttons stays there.
- Closing Next Up during the credits marks the episode watched, and SyncPlay
  guests start when the host does.
- Downloaded videos no longer freeze every few seconds with many downloads.

## Seerr, servers and privacy

- A request Radarr or Sonarr hasn't found yet says what it is waiting on.
- Seerr settings show whether push is set up, with Send Test Notification.
- An Emby server saved as Jellyfin loads its Home again.
- The Live TV guide marks programmes Emby flags as new.
- "Allow self-signed certificates" now covers only your own servers.
  Diagnostic reports leave out addresses, tokens and passwords.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.
